title: Mixed Event — Run! Sports Festival! Committee Rush — Episode6 Passing the Baton

meta.Event Outline: Saki invites Haruka to join the Sports Festival Planning Committee. Together with fellow committee member Emu, they strive to make the Sports Festival a fun and joyful event, but how will it turn out?

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't forget about the special scoring system for the bamboo pole tug-of-war.

rows.Speaker: 1st Year Committee Member
rows.Line: Okay, got it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Haruka!
I can't find the bread anywhere!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You mean for the bread obstacle course? I was told they put them in the refrigerator in the teacher's office.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, thank goodness!
Thanks! I'll go get them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew... Looks like things are finally starting to settle down.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And it's just the big relay race left to wrap things up. We might just finish today without any incidents.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Ow...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, are you all right? Your leg, it's really swollen. We should get you to the nurse's office!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: But I'm supposed to be in the relay...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What happened?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Kiritani! Well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You got hurt during the last race? It looks pretty swollen. You really should have the nurse look at it.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: But I still need to do the relay. If I don't, I'll just be letting everyone down...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but I think it would be best to go see the nurse. You don't want to make it any worse.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't worry. I'll run in your place.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
You're the substitute, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I'll go let the referees know about the change. Tenma, will you make sure she gets to the nurse's office?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry...
I know how busy you are...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's not a problem.
I'll make sure to do my best.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We'll be cheering you on, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks. I don't plan on losing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I informed them about the switch, so everything should be set. I should practice transferring the baton pass a little more...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just heard! You're going to be in the relay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. One of the other girls hurt her leg. I'm registered as the substitute, so I'm taking her place...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?! Is she okay?
I hope she wasn't crying?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's fine. A couple of the other girls took her to the nurse's office. I think she just twisted her ankle a little.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Phew, that's a relief...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So that means you're passing the baton to me then!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I forgot that you're the runner right after me. That's quite the coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: To be honest, I'm a little worried about being able to pass you the baton. I haven't done a relay since elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Don't worry, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We've been on the planning committee together this whole time, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Think about all the hard work we did!
We're the best pair around here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So I'm sure our baton pass will be perfect!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Otori...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We still have a little time left before the relay, so let's practice some!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We have to win and make sure the girl who got hurt will smile too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, you're right... Let's win this!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: And now for today's final event, the big relay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, it's starting!
Time to cheer Emu on again!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Friend
rows.Line: Mafuyu, you're the anchor in the relay, right?! Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thanks. I'll do my best.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka, you got this!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good luck, Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Time to win...!)

rows.Speaker: Committee Member A
rows.Line: On your marks... Get set...

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: And they're off!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: The third-year team have taken an early lead, followed by the second years and then the first years.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The first years are a little behind, but we can still win if we maintain this pace...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We're already closing the gap between us and the third years. We can do this...!)

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: It looks like the second-year team is looking to move up!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: And they've taken the lead! Now, we have the third years in second with the first years right on their heels! This is going to be a nail biter, folks!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This might not be as easy as I thought...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I need to gain as much ground on them as possible!)

rows.Speaker: Relay Member
rows.Line: Kiritani, here...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Leave it to me!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: The first years' baton is now in the hands of Haruka Kiritani from 1-C!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I need to close that gap and get the baton to Emu as fast as possible!)

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Kiritani in lane 1 is on fire! She's passed the third years and is in a dead heat with the second years!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow! Go, Haruka!
You're doing awesome!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You can do it, Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Everyone is cheering me on!
I can't let them down!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's all you, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's time to win!!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Kiritani brought the first years back into a fight for first place! She passes her baton to Otori just as the second years pass theirs!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line:
It's all up to the anchors now!
Who will be victorious?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's so fast! She might be faster than everyone on the track and field team...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But Emu's right there with her!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Emu Otori and Mafuyu Asahina are neck and neck! It's still anybody's race!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Otori...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Emu! Emu! C'mon, you can do it!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Go! Go! All the way to the finish line!!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There's no way I'm losing!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: And the winner is...
